name: Niina Junpei
source:
Your kouhai, Junpei arrives in year 2, though you can meet him while shopping in year 1, while he's still in middle school. He joins Judo after being harassed into it by [url=http://vndb.org/c1270]Arashi[/url], and acts young and carefree and fawns over pretty upperclassmen you, almost like a little brother. Friendly; happy and optimistic, he gets along with people easily. Junpei always takes care of his appearance and follows the latest trends. He is good at both sports and studies.

[From [url=http://steflee.wordpress.com/2010/03/02/information-on-tokimeki-memorial-girls-side-3rd-story/]26 Hours[/url] and [url=http://tokimekimemorialgs.wikia.com/wiki/Category:Tokimeki_Memorial_Girl%27s_Side_3rd_Story]Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side Wiki[/url]]
